review.Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-or-later: sharp's Windows packages: its Apache-2.0 binding and the LGPL-3.0-or-later libvips in one package (two packages elsewhere), each on its own terms as above
review.EPL-2.0: weak copyleft: redistribution unchanged is allowed with the licence text and a note on where its source is; a changed copy must publish the change
review.FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0: Functional Source License: not open source until it turns Apache-2.0 two years after each release; use and redistribution are allowed except for a competing product
review.LGPL-3.0-or-later: copyleft library shipped as a native binary: redistribution needs the licence text, a way to get its source, and the freedom to replace the library
review.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft: redistribution unchanged is allowed with the licence text and a note on where its source is
